original_ai_output.title_zh: 青年联盟赞扬安全机构在高原州持续开展打击不安全行动
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 高原州青年团体联盟在阿布贾举行新闻发布会，赞扬国家安全局（DSS）、机动警察和州属安全机构“彩虹行动”在高原州持续开展打击不安全行动。联盟称这些行动已取得积极成效，包括改善对求助的响应和逮捕部分犯罪分子。联盟同时表示，针对上述机构的偏见与选择性执法指控源于一份请愿书和视频，认为其可能误导公众。联盟呼吁政府彻查相关指控，并称安全人员在巴金拉迪、里约姆、巴萨、博科斯和曼古等地遭袭，有人员伤亡。

key_facts.fact: 高原州青年团体联盟在阿布贾举行新闻发布会，赞扬DSS、机动警察和“彩虹行动”在高原州打击不安全的行动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A Coalition of Youth Groups in Plateau has commended the Department of State Services (DSS), the Mobile Police and Operation Rainbow, a Plateau-owned security outfit over the ongoing operations against insecurity in the state.

key_facts.fact: 联盟称此次发布会是对有关三支安全机构存在偏见和选择性执法指控的回应
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Mwantiri particularly said that the news conference was a reaction to the allegation of bias and selected operations jointly carried out by the three security outfits in the state.

key_facts.fact: 联盟称一份10月5日的请愿书和相关视频正在流传，可能误导公众
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He said that a petition dated Oct. 5 and video clips had been in circulation in that regard.

key_facts.fact: 联盟称联合安全行动已取得积极成果，包括改善对求助的响应和逮捕部分犯罪分子
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the joint ongoing security operations had so far yielded positive results, including improved response to distress calls and arrest of some criminal elements in the state.

key_facts.fact: 联盟称6月1日巴金拉迪一处新部署的DSS基地遭袭，8月23日里约姆Jol社区两村庄遭袭致两名DSS人员死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: On June 1, a newly deployed DSS base at Nding Sesut, Fan in Barkin Ladi was attacked. Similarly, on Aug. 23, Tanjol and Tarai villages of Jol community in Riyom LGA were attacked and two DSS personnel lost their lives.

key_facts.fact: 联盟称部分机动警察和一名“彩虹行动”人员在博科斯、里约姆和巴金拉迪附近的不同事件中据报被杀
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Some mobile police officers and one personnel of Operation Rainbow were reportedly killed in separate incidents around Bokkos, Riyom and Barkin Ladi

key_facts.fact: 联盟呼吁政府彻查相关指控以查明事实
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He called on the government to thoroughly investigate the allegations to establish facts and ensure accountability where necessary.

uncertainties: 有关安全机构存在偏见和选择性执法的指控尚未证实，联盟仅称其可能误导公众
安全人员伤亡数字来自联盟单方面陈述，未获独立核实
该报道为单一来源（尼日利亚通讯社），尚缺乏交叉验证
